digest_markdown:
• [1] A supply chain attack on SolarWinds' Orion IT monitoring system, used by over 30,000 organizations, allowed hackers to deliver backdoor malware in a software update, compromising approximately 18,000 customers. [1]
• [1] A GhostAction supply chain attack on GitHub repositories exposed 3,325 secrets, including tokens and keys across widely used platforms, with at least 817 repositories affected. [2]
• [1] Chainguard, a software supply chain security company, was accused by PHP developers of revealing critical bugs in the open-source scripting language ahead of a planned official disclosure. [3]
• [1] A compromised LiteLLM 1.107.0 release published to PyPI and distributed through official container images allowed hackers to steal developer credentials and alter the release workflow, potentially exposing sensitive information. [4]
• [1] [2]
